svg.title: Private workspaces over a shared immutable snapshot
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of an AI visual concept. Three independent clients have private upper state and local Packed readers. Mutable metadata and the producer are outside object storage. Dashed paths show pending finalized-upload hint wiring only.

g.text: Solid: logical requests. Upper/control and payload paths shown once; each client has both.
Hint wiring pending; object geometry is schematic.
